## The water commitment


A publication that showcases Eni’s projects to optimize water use, promote reuse, and ensure access to safe water in the areas where we operate. A journey through innovation, responsibility, and tangible impact to safeguard a resource essential for the future.


[view more](https://www.eni.com/content/dam/enicom/documents/eng/media/pubblicazioni-editoriali/Book_Water_ENG.pdf)
